typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ACCOUNT as string,
		CURRENCY_CD as string,
		YDYS_SETTLM_DT_AMT as integer,
		TDYS_SETTLM_DT_AMT as integer,
		GI_TDYS_TRD_DT_AMT as integer,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		GI_TDYS_SETTLM_AMT as integer,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		ISO_CCY_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ACCOUNT as string,
		CURRENCY_CD as string,
		YDYS_SETTLM_DT_AMT as integer,
		TDYS_SETTLM_DT_AMT as integer,
		GI_TDYS_TRD_DT_AMT as integer,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		GI_TDYS_SETTLM_AMT as integer,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		ISO_CCY_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ACCOUNT,
		CURRENCY_CD,
		YDYS_SETTLM_DT_AMT,
		TDYS_SETTLM_DT_AMT,
		GI_TDYS_TRD_DT_AMT,
		EFFDATE,
		CLIENT_NBR,
		GI_TDYS_SETTLM_AMT,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		ISO_CCY_CD),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
